description: Niche prompt formulas for marketplace card series (perfume, clothing, electronics).

perfume.title: Парфюмерия
perfume.negative_prompt: extra bottles, plastic cheap look, cluttered shelf, watermark, text artifacts, deformed glass
perfume.lifestyle_scene: stylish marble vanity or walnut shelf in a premium home interior, soft golden-hour window light

cover.prompt_formula: Centered perfume bottle hero shot, crystal glass reflections, soft gradient mist, luxury studio lighting, clean negative space at the top for headline, photorealistic, 8k

macro.prompt_formula: Extreme macro of perfume bottle glass, engraved cap details, shimmering liquid inside, micro-contrast, premium material close-up, photorealistic

lifestyle.prompt_formula: Perfume bottle placed on {lifestyle_scene}, shallow depth of field, aspirational beauty lifestyle, natural reflections, no clutter

technical.prompt_formula: Perfume bottle on clean neutral seamless background, even softbox light, safe empty zones for volume/notes specs overlay, catalogue accuracy

trust.prompt_formula: Elegant perfume composition with soft bokeh, premium gift-unboxing mood, space for authenticity badge, calm luxury palette

clothing.title: Одежда
clothing.negative_prompt: deformed body, extra limbs, wrinkled cheap fabric, wrong proportions, watermark, logo copy, messy background
clothing.lifestyle_scene: bright minimal loft apartment or clean urban street, soft daylight, fashion editorial mood

cover.prompt_formula: E-commerce clothing hero: garment perfectly centered, crisp fabric texture, professional catalog lighting, clean negative space for title, photorealistic marketplace card

macro.prompt_formula: Macro close-up of clothing fabric weave, stitching quality, zipper or button detail, tactile premium textile realism

lifestyle.prompt_formula: Clothing item styled in {lifestyle_scene}, natural pose-friendly composition, fashion lookbook lighting, believable shadows

technical.prompt_formula: Garment on neutral seamless background, front-facing, even light, reserved zones for size chart and material composition overlays

trust.prompt_formula: Premium apparel presentation emphasizing neat seams and finish, soft studio light, space for quality guarantee badge

electronics.title: Электроника
electronics.negative_prompt: cheap plastic glare, wrong ports, melted edges, extra buttons, watermark, unreadable screens, clutter
electronics.lifestyle_scene: modern desk setup with soft LED accent light, clean tech workspace, subtle reflections on matte surfaces

cover.prompt_formula: Centered electronics product hero shot, precise edges, controlled specular highlights, dark-to-light gradient studio, space for headline, ultra-sharp photorealism

macro.prompt_formula: Macro detail of device materials, ports, buttons, antenna lines or mesh, engineering precision close-up, crisp micro-contrast

lifestyle.prompt_formula: Device placed in {lifestyle_scene}, believable scale, soft ambient tech lighting, lifestyle usability scene without clutter

technical.prompt_formula: Electronics product on clean neutral background, orthographic-friendly angle, even light, large safe zones for battery/CPU/spec callouts

trust.prompt_formula: Premium tech still-life with confident minimal composition, soft rim light, reserved area for warranty and authenticity badge
